title: gpu groundwork backend setting and gles parity

commit.merge_subject: merge: gpu groundwork backend setting and gles parity

description:
Deliverable C of the GPU groundwork (owner request
2026-11-12): a safe GLES context, a capability probe, and a
single-frame bilinear demosaic parity harness, all host-honest.

native (gles/GlesPipeline.{h,cpp}, Android-only, compiled by
:app:assembleDebug; the desktop build never compiles this target):
- EglSession with the grafika EglCore topology only (Apache-2.0,
  topology not verbatim): open builds display -> context -> 1x1
  pbuffer on the calling thread; release tears down in the exact
  reverse order and is safe on partially-opened sessions.
- probeCapabilities: context, GL version/renderer/extensions,
  parse, compute availability, EXT_color_buffer_float, max texture
  size. All fields are what the device reported, never a guess.
- demosaicParity: GLES 3.1 CORE only — the stage-1-normalized CFA
  goes in as a scalar-float SSBO, the GLSL ES 3.10 compute shader
  runs the bilinear
changed: docs: gpu groundwork baseline and stage contract
feat: render backend setting with real encoder diagnostics
feat: gles probe and single-frame demosaic parity
